QuestInfo.name: 10 Boogies's Request
QuestInfo.0: After the #o1140130# case closed, #p1103004# still seems to need you for something. You wonder what. Better go talk to #b#p1103004##k and find out.
QuestInfo.1:
#p1103004# thanks you for helping her solve the mystery, but tells you she has a little predicament. She can't leave her post to submit her report! She wonders if you could deliver the report to her boss. Your new task is to deliver the #t4032320# to #b#p1101002##k in #b#m130000000##k.

Take the ship headed to #b#m130000000# from the #bEreve Bound Platform#k north of #b#m104020000##k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the report to #p1101002# and received a reward. You noticed that he had a very peculiar way of speaking which, to you, seemed totally inappropriate yet absolutely proper in tone. It reminded you of someone...

default.0: Haven't you gone to #b#m130000000##k yet? Please go to #m130000000# and submit the report for me. Otherwise, #b#p1101002##k will throw a fit, and I don't like being grilled by #p1101002#...
